title: International Postgraduate Programmes, First Semester 2027
institution: Faculty of Tropical Medicine, Mahidol University (Mahidol Bangkok School of Tropical Medicine)
about: The Mahidol Bangkok School of Tropical Medicine accepts applications from 1 October 2026 to 31 May 2027 for first-semester 2027 admission to its international postgraduate programmes, including the PhD and MSc in Tropical Medicine and the Diploma in Tropical Medicine and Hygiene.
requirements: Translated degree certificates and transcripts, photo, passport copy and CV
